title: Kitchen hygiene fundamentals
objectives: Identify contamination hazards and safe working habits
method: Inspect your uniform and cover cuts with suitable waterproof dressings
Wash hands thoroughly with soap and running water, including thumbs and fingertips, then dry
Identify raw and ready-to-eat work zones
Check the station before beginning and report hazards
commonMistakes: Using gloves instead of washing hands
knowledgeChecks: Why are gloves not a substitute?

title: Preventing cross-contamination
method: Plan separate storage with raw food below ready-to-eat food
Prepare ready-to-eat items away from raw food
Clean and disinfect surfaces according to product instructions
Report suspected contamination and isolate affected food
practical: Map contamination routes on a mock station
knowledgeChecks: Why store raw food below cooked food?
What should happen to contaminated salad?

title: Personal hygiene and illness reporting
method: Check fitness for work before entering kitchen
Report vomiting or diarrhoea immediately and follow exclusion policy, normally at least 48 hours after symptoms stop
Remove jewellery according to policy and secure hair
Discuss return to work with manager
practical: Role-play reporting illness and demonstrate handwashing
knowledgeChecks: Who must be told about symptoms?

title: Temperature monitoring
objectives: Measure core temperature and interpret limits
method: Verify probe accuracy by approved procedure
Measure thickest part away from bone
Compare with validated limit such as 70°C for 2 minutes or equivalent
Record result and isolate or continue cooking if required
knowledgeChecks: What action follows a failed check?

title: Cleaning and disinfection
objectives: Distinguish soil removal and microbial control
method: Apply approved disinfectant at specified dilution and contact time
Rinse if label requires and air dry
practical: Write and demonstrate a cleaning schedule

title: Knife skills and safety
objectives: Use a stable board and controlled grip
method: Grip handle securely and curl guiding fingertips
Place knife safely when not in use
knowledgeChecks: What should you do if a knife falls?

title: Precision vegetable cuts
objectives: Produce consistent julienne, baton and dice
method: Compare dimensions and reserve suitable trim
practical: Produce three uniform cuts and compare cooking consistency
knowledgeChecks: Why do uniform cuts cook evenly?

title: Knife selection and maintenance
method: Carry point down at side following workplace policy
Practise sharpening only with trained supervision
Clean and dry before secure storage
practical: Identify knives and demonstrate safe storage
knowledgeChecks: Why remove damaged knives from use?

title: Vegetable preparation and yield
method: Calculate usable weight divided by purchase weight times 100
practical: Compare two preparation methods and calculate yield
knowledgeChecks: What is yield from 400 g usable out of 500 g?

title: Mise en place
objectives: Organise ingredients and tools before cooking
method: Weigh and prepare ingredients in order
practical: Set up a supervised soup station
knowledgeChecks: What does mise en place achieve?

title: Planning a preparation list
method: Schedule long cooking and cooling tasks first
practical: Create a prep list for 20 covers

title: Weighing and recipe scaling
ingredients: 400 g vegetables, 200 g rice, 600 ml stock for four portions
method: Divide six target portions by four original portions
Measure 600 g vegetables, 300 g rice and 900 ml stock
Check pan capacity and adjust cooking process separately
practical: Scale a second recipe and verify weights
knowledgeChecks: What is the scaling factor from four to six?

title: Receiving and storing ingredients
method: Check packaging, dates and temperatures against policy
Rotate by earliest expiry and record checks
practical: Inspect a mock delivery and record rejection reasons

title: Essential cooking methods
method: Boil one portion and steam another
Roast a third with a little oil
practical: Compare three methods using identical vegetables

title: Egg cookery
method: Check egg condition and approved source
Boil two eggs until fully cooked
Cook gently while stirring until fully set
knowledgeChecks: Why does high heat toughen eggs?
How is raw egg contamination prevented?

title: Rice and pasta
method: Cook rice and pasta separately to instructions
Check texture and drain where appropriate
Serve promptly or cool rapidly using validated workplace procedure
commonMistakes: Leaving cooked rice at room temperature
knowledgeChecks: Why is cooked rice a safety risk if left warm?
How do you check pasta texture?

title: Soups and simple dishes
ingredients: 300 g vegetables, 500 ml stock, 10 ml oil
method: Add stock and simmer until tender
Taste with clean spoon and adjust seasoning
practical: Produce two portions and record yield
knowledgeChecks: How can soup consistency be adjusted?
